images.key_dataflow: Observed modalities enter one stock-compatible full-volume backbone. Shared low/mid decoding preserves mature anatomy context, after which scar and pure-edema receive asymmetric high-resolution routes: LGE provides the principal scar localization evidence, while T2 provides the principal edema evidence. The pathology logits rejoin anatomy logits only at the final conditional class competition and deployment-compatible decoder.

images.key_dataflow: The observed modalities are encoded and selectively routed into shared, private and interaction representation banks. Retrieved task evidence is combined with nnU-Net anatomy, anchor probability, uncertainty, connected-component and prototype evidence to form separate scar and edema proposals. Soft regions of interest then drive different scar and edema refiners, whose deltas are written back through bounded gates around the anchor rather than replacing the whole baseline prediction. The Cine lane separately aligns multi-frame anatomy/features before temporal aggregation.

structural_differences: CARE-ASE is a single stock-compatible full-volume reconstruction system with asymmetric scar and edema branches; it gives the new branches direct end-to-end reconstruction responsibility while retaining the mature shared decoder.

SRR-v3 is an evidence-selection and bounded-correction system around a strong nnU-Net anchor. Its distinctive burden is the retrieval/prototype/proposal/soft-ROI/refiner chain and the requirement to prove that each stage reaches final logits.
MoSAIC is a coarse-to-fine multi-network system with independent pathology experts and a separate ED-anchored cine pipeline. It does not use SRR-style dictionaries or anchor-bounded correction.

The no-T2 rule is most explicit and computationally strict in CARE-ASE; SRR-v3 expresses it through availability masking, reliable-label supervision and fail-closed edema correction; MoSAIC's figure does not expose the same row-wise five-class contract.
